quality.title: OCR quality & coverage
quality.subtitle: OCR noise and index completeness indicators
quality.shortWords: Very short words (≤ 2 letters, likely OCR noise)
quality.shortWordsHelp: Words of 1 to 2 letters. Rate = number of these words ÷ total number of unique words in the vocabulary.
quality.hapaxHelp: A hapax is a word whose total number of occurrences in the whole index is exactly 1. Rate = number of hapax ÷ total number of unique words.
quality.hapaxNote: Hapax: words appearing only once in the whole indexed corpus ({{words}} words, i.e. {{pct}}% of the vocabulary).
quality.hapaxNote2: A high rate of hapax or short words often indicates OCR recognition errors.
quality.pagesNote: Pages with indexed text = pages containing at least one recognized and indexed word. Pages without text = pages submitted to OCR but where no word was indexed (blank, illegible or non-textual pages).
quality.coverageUnknown: Coverage unknown — regenerate the index to enable tracking of OCR pages without text.
quality.registresNoPeriod: Registres with no period set (excluded from temporal statistics)
